_comment: Your projects: absolute paths of local checkouts (the guard hook allows only these, plus the rca skill folder; `git -C` may only target them). Optional per project: display_name (how people know it), web_url (for code links; default: the checkout's `origin` remote), sync ("<remote>/<branch>": NIMI keeps this NIMI-only copy updated; it never touches checkouts with uncommitted changes or local commits). Describe each project in <name>.md and add it to INDEX.md.

shop.description: Example: an online shop backend (API, workers, scheduled jobs)

dashboards.description: Example: a BI / dashboarding tool that sends alerts about query results
